items.title: Celtics Teeing Up for Kids
items.bioHtml: Celtics Teeing Up for Kids golf tournament brings Celtics players, alumni, and celebrities together to support Shamrock Foundation programs. Benefits Boys & Girls Clubs of Boston and other youth-serving organizations. Part of Foundation's comprehensive community investment strategy.

items.title: Drive Fore Kids Charity Golf
items.bioHtml: Drive Fore Kids Charity Golf Tournament at Falmouth Country Club features Red Sox legend Jon Lester, Bruins stars Tyler Seguin and Tuukka Rask, and 'The Office' actor Brian Baumgartner competing for $265K prize purse. Benefits MaineHealth Barbara Bush Children's Hospital and Dempsey Center. June 19-22.

items.title: Bruins Foundation Golf Tournament
items.bioHtml: Boston Bruins Foundation Golf Tournament enters its 22nd year bringing together Bruins players, alumni, and celebrities for charity. Supports health and wellness, education, and athletics organizations throughout New England. Part of Foundation's $68M+ charitable legacy. Premium networking with Boston sports community.

items.title: Sean McDonough Celebrity Golf Classic
items.bioHtml: Sean McDonough Celebrity Golf Classic honors Will McDonough's legacy while funding cardiac amyloidosis research at Brigham and Women's Hospital. ESPN broadcaster Sean McDonough hosts at prestigious Boston Golf Club in Hingham. VIP reception, celebrity appearances, auction. Mass General Brigham partnership.

items.title: Sports Museum Celebrity Golf Classic
items.bioHtml: Sports Museum Celebrity Golf Classic pairs each foursome with a Boston sports celebrity at Renaissance Golf Club. Benefits The Sports Museum and educational programs Boston vs. Bullies and Stand Strong. Morning round, afternoon round, or both available. Premier New England charity golf event that sells out annually. June 15, 2026.

items.title: US Challenge Cup
items.bioHtml: US Challenge Cup ages 8-19 provides qualifying to Scott Robertson Memorial, Junior World Golf Championships, Golfweek events.

items.title: US Kids Golf Local Tour
items.bioHtml: US Kids Golf Local Tour provides 8 one-day tournaments + Local Tour Championship using points system.

items.title: First Tee Summer Programs
items.bioHtml: First Tee Summer Programs run Monday-Thursday at William Devine Golf Course, Franklin Park. PGA pros. Ages 7-17.

items.title: Nehoiden Summer Junior Golf
items.bioHtml: Nehoiden Summer Junior Golf provides camp with medical clearance required. PGA Jr. League during summer. Wellesley.

items.title: CityGolf Junior Program
items.bioHtml: CityGolf Junior Program runs 5-week programs: 3 weeks coaching + 2 weeks handicapped events. PGA Class 'A' instructors.

items.title: Desert Smash Celebrity Pickleball
items.bioHtml: Desert Smash Celebrity Pickleball Challenge joins the established 21-year celebrity tennis charity event at La Quinta Resort & Club. Celebrities and athletes compete on the Smirnoff Smash Court in high-energy matches. Growing presence reflects pickleball's crossover appeal with celebrity culture. March annually.

items.title: Emmys Pickleball Slam
items.bioHtml: Emmys Pickleball Slam brings television stars together for Television Academy Foundation charity. Participants include Phil Keoghan (Amazing Race), Sugar Ray Leonard, Kunal Nayyar (Big Bang Theory), and more competing with pro players. 2025 supported California wildfire firefighter relief. Calabasas Pickleball Club venue.

items.title: Stephen Colbert’s Pickled
items.bioHtml: Stephen Colbert's Pickled on CBS was the first organized celebrity pickleball tournament, benefiting Comic Relief US. Features Will Ferrell, Emma Watson, Kelly Rowland, Tig Notaro, and more competing for the Colbert Cup. Two-hour special streams on Paramount+. Charity focus on homelessness impact on children and families.

items.title: PPA Celebrity Pickleball Showdown
items.bioHtml: PPA Celebrity Pickleball Showdown at PPA Worlds features elite athletes from other sports competing alongside pickleball's biggest stars. NBA Hall of Famer Dirk Nowitzki, NFL legend Terrell Owens, and MLB star J.D. Martinez team with Ben Johns, Anna Leigh Waters, and other pros. Premier crossover entertainment.

items.title: Celebrity Pickleball Bash
items.bioHtml: Celebrity Pickleball Bash tours nationally with equity partners including Knicks star Jalen Brunson, comedian Anthony Anderson, and TV personalities Mario Lopez and Eric Decker. Celebrities team with professional pickleball players in festival atmosphere. Local charity partners benefit at each stop. San Francisco, San Antonio, Las Vegas, NYC.

items.title: Volo Sports Charity Tournaments
items.bioHtml: Volo Sports Charity Tournaments like Dinkin' It With Santa and Turkey Bowl support Volo Kids Foundation.

items.title: Life Time Pickleball Tournaments
items.bioHtml: Life Time Pickleball Tournaments offer weekend competition at various levels with PPA partnership events.

items.title: UTR Sports Pickleball Tournaments
items.bioHtml: UTR Sports Pickleball Tournaments provide local and regional competition with rating-based brackets.

items.title: Boston Red Sox Celebrity Classic
items.bioHtml: Boston Red Sox Celebrity Classic brings Red Sox players, MLB legends, and sports celebrities to Fort Myers for charity. 33rd annual event includes Celebrity Golf Classic, Boston 'Tee' Party auction, and Dinner on the Diamond at JetBlue Park. Benefits Golisano Children's Hospital. $15.8M+ raised since 1993.

items.title: Red Sox Alumni Legends Events
items.bioHtml: Red Sox are exploring an Alumni Home Run Derby at Fenway Park following the Milwaukee Brewers' successful 2025 alumni event. Potential participants include David Ortiz, Manny Ramirez, Dustin Pedroia, Nomar Garciaparra, and other Red Sox legends. Historic venue celebration connecting generations of fans.

items.title: MLB All-Star Celebrity Softball Game
items.bioHtml: MLB All-Star Celebrity Softball Game brings together athletes from other sports, entertainers, and former MLB legends during All-Star Week festivities. High-profile entertainment event with charitable impact. 2026 takes place at Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia alongside Home Run Derby and All-Star Game.

items.title: Red Sox Foundation
items.bioHtml: Red Sox Foundation serves as official charity of the Boston Red Sox. RBI & Jr. RBI programs provide free team equipment, uniforms, field access, and umpires to 2,000+ Boston youth annually. Scholarship programs empower 300+ students with mentorship, financial support, and college access. Baseball as platform for community transformation.

items.title: Las Vegas Kickoff Classic
items.bioHtml: Las Vegas Kickoff Classic brings 60-65 teams to Vegas in March. Season-opening tournament.

items.title: MSBL Holiday Classic
items.bioHtml: MSBL Holiday Classic offers January baseball in Osceola, FL during MLK Jr. weekend. Winter escape.

items.title: Cape Cod Classic
items.bioHtml: Cape Cod Classic provides competition on iconic Cape Cod League fields where college stars play.

items.title: Cooperstown Classic
items.bioHtml: Cooperstown Classic delivers Father's Day baseball at Hall of Fame on historic fields. Generational celebration.

items.title: Roy Hobbs World Series
items.bioHtml: Roy Hobbs World Series runs October/November in Fort Myers. Popular among Boston Metro Baseball League teams.

items.title: MSBL/MABL Fall Classic
items.bioHtml: MSBL/MABL Fall Classic provides November competition in Florida at MLB Spring Training stadiums.

items.title: MSBL/MABL World Series
items.bioHtml: MSBL/MABL World Series brings 320+ teams to Arizona October/November on MLB Spring Training fields. 30 divisions.

items.title: Central New England Baseball Association
items.bioHtml: Central New England Baseball Association provides adult baseball for Central MA players west of Boston.

items.title: Volo Sports Softball
items.bioHtml: Volo Sports Softball delivers social adult softball. Team or free agent registration. Post-game gatherings build community.

items.title: BSSC Softball
items.bioHtml: BSSC Softball provides adult recreational softball through Greater Boston's largest sports org. Coed and single-gender divisions.

items.title: Boston Amateur Baseball League
items.bioHtml: Boston Amateur Baseball League delivers adult amateur baseball in Boston area. Organized competition for structured league play.

items.title: Boston Park League
items.bioHtml: Boston Park League is oldest continuing amateur baseball league in US. Highly competitive play with historic tradition.

items.title: Boston Metro Baseball League
items.bioHtml: Boston Metro Baseball League is largest in MA/New England. Divisions: 18+, 28+ (Boston/MetroWest), 38+ Masters. Wood bats only. 18-24 game seasons with playoffs.

items.title: Starland Summer Clinics
items.bioHtml: Starland Summer Clinics provide 10 weeks of development with Dr. Dish and Vertimax technology.

items.title: HUB Sports Tournaments
items.bioHtml: HUB Sports Tournaments provide playoff competition for league participants with competitive divisions.

items.title: BASE Hoopz Summer League
items.bioHtml: BASE Hoopz Summer League extends year-round programming into summer competition. Academic requirements remain.

items.title: Boston Elite Basketball Camps
items.bioHtml: Boston Elite Basketball Camps deliver summer sessions emphasizing skills, game knowledge, and confidence building.

items.title: Nike/Liverpool FC Camp
items.bioHtml: Nike Soccer Camp at Mass Maritime features Liverpool FC International Academy staff bringing Premier League methodology to Buzzards Bay. Overnight and day options. Ages 7-16. Nike t-shirt included.

items.title: Revolution Foundation
items.bioHtml: New England Revolution Foundation supports youth soccer development and community access throughout the region. Programs include youth camps, community clinics, and grassroots development initiatives. MLS team community investment making soccer accessible to underserved populations.

items.title: Inter Milan Academy New England
items.bioHtml: Inter Academy New England operates year-round in MetroWest as technical partnership with FC Internazionale. UEFA A/B-licensed coaches with 5+ years Inter training. Ages 6-14. Financially accessible with scholarships available.

items.title: SL Benfica Camp
items.bioHtml: Benfica Camp delivers training from Globe Soccer's Best Academy 2015 and 2019. Coaches from Seixal academy bring methodology that developed João Félix, Bernardo Silva, Rúben Dias. Boston and Worcester locations. Ages 6-16. $549.

items.title: Paris Saint-Germain Academy Camp
items.bioHtml: PSG Academy Camp brings French football excellence through official club coaches from Paris. The methodology that developed Mbappé and countless internationals. Nike kit included. Ages 6-15.

items.title: Manchester City Camp
items.bioHtml: Manchester City Camp delivers Guardiola's positional play and technical excellence through official City coaches. Ages 8-15 train 9am-2pm. PUMA kit included. $599.

items.title: Atlético de Madrid Camp
items.bioHtml: Atlético de Madrid Camp brings La Liga excellence to Cambridge at BB&N Grove Street Campus. Official coaches deliver tactical discipline and fighting spirit. Ages U6-U18 train 8am-2pm.

items.title: FC Barcelona Academy Camp
items.bioHtml: Official Barça Academy with UEFA coaches from Barcelona. The methodology that shaped Messi, Xavi, Iniesta. Ages 6-17.

items.title: Real Madrid Foundation Camp
items.bioHtml: Real Madrid Foundation Soccer Camp brings the world's most decorated club's methodology to Boston. UEFA-licensed coaches from Spain deliver training that develops Real Madrid academy players. Ages 6-15. Full-day 9am-3pm includes kit, diploma, evaluation. $599.

items.title: Mass Youth Soccer Districts Program
items.bioHtml: Mass Youth Soccer Districts Program delivers summer development in pressure-free environments. No standings kept—pure focus on player development without competitive stress.

items.title: BAYS (Boston Area Youth Soccer)
items.bioHtml: BAYS (Boston Area Youth Soccer) coordinates spring and fall seasons with tiered divisions for travel teams across Greater Boston. Organized structure for youth competition.

items.title: Barça Academy Summer Camps
items.bioHtml: Barça Academy Summer Camps bring 5 days of official FC Barcelona training. UEFA-licensed coaches from Barcelona. Training kit included. Select players may train in Spain.

items.title: Revolution Academy Summer Camps
items.bioHtml: Revolution Academy Summer Camps deliver 4-day experiences coached by official Revs Academy staff using 'Revs Way' player development. Ages 7-14 at various New England locations.

items.title: Boston SCORES Summer Camps
items.bioHtml: Boston SCORES Summer Camps combine soccer, poetry, and service learning in week-long August sessions. Ages 7+. $150/week at East Boston fields. Building student-athletes.

items.title: Drive Fore Kids Charity Golf
items.bioHtml: Drive Fore Kids Charity Golf Tournament at Falmouth Country Club features Red Sox legend Jon Lester, Bruins stars Tyler Seguin and Tuukka Rask, and 'The Office' actor Brian Baumgartner competing for $265K prize purse. items.title: Bruins Foundation Golf Tournament

Calabasas Pickleball Club venue.

Charity focus on homelessness impact on children and families.
